governing_rule: Clause V2-SEC-4: Any case involving exported customer data to an external destination must be denied unless a security-approved override explicitly names that exact destination and exact use case.
conflicting_signals: Manager note approves temporary override for exporting sanitized billing samples to analytics sandbox mirror for incident review
Clause V2-SEC-4 requires denial for exported customer data to external destinations without security-approved override
Clause V2-SEC-5 gives precedence to v2 clauses when manager note lacks security countersign
reason: The case involves exported customer data to an external destination (external hosted mirror). The manager note lacks security countersign and does not explicitly name the exact destination 'analytics sandbox mirror eu' nor the exact use case 'vendor escalation' required by Clause V2-SEC-4. Therefore, Clause V2-SEC-5 applies, giving precedence to v2 policy over the manager note.
